title: Center with one grid line
summary: place-items: center is the shortest centering recipe there is.
explanation: place-items is shorthand for align-items and justify-items. On a grid container with a single cell, it centers the child in that cell, both ways.
Unlike the flexbox version, this also centers several children stacked on top of each other: each gets its own row.
tryThis: Add a second child to .stage and see it stack.
